source_findings: The documented execution batches are individual base-category partitions with controller levels 13, 14, 15 and a combined levels-through-11 batch with controller LEVEL=-1. Category identities must be supplied through private runtime configuration.

Quantile mask exponent reads global controller LEVEL, not the fitted level loop variable. The combined batch therefore uses exponent 0.25 even for fitted levels 10 and 11; separate base partitions use 0.35. Orchestration must preserve this distinction.

The actual training call supplies one prepared sample to runQBags. Supplied populations are reused across bags; the default bag count is one. Automatic fresh resampling is only the function fallback when data is None.
Training search iterations are int((2.2 if fitted level <=9 else 1.66)*(16-min(fitted level,12))*speed factor), where speed factor is 0.25 for super speed, 0.5 for speed, otherwise 1.

Forecast queries repeat after two weight-budget normalizations with clipping on each pass. Low levels use squared weights across all 28 horizons; high levels use power 1.5 separately per horizon. Perturbed query predictions are averaged per series and horizon.

Final median-total adjustment covers available levels 1 through 9 only, with strength 0.7 normally or 1 in speed modes. All levels then undo their hierarchy multiplier. CSV output rounds to three decimals; the independent component intentionally returns unrounded native units.
scope: Inspected configuration findings, not yet a connected or qualified execution schedule.
